DZA.note: The registered AI bill is not stated to address a named harm from AI.

facts.fact: The National People's Assembly's secretary general says the Assembly has adopted AI-based cybersecurity solutions and AI tools for automatic transcription and translation of debates, which gave a considerable efficiency gain.
facts.system: APN AI transcription, translation and cybersecurity tools

systems.system: APN AI transcription and translation tools

facts.fact: The National People's Assembly's secretary general says a bill by a group of deputies to regulate the development and use of AI was recently registered and would be examined by the Assembly bureau.

DZA.note: No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated.

facts.fact: The Assembly's secretary general says the Assembly has a partnership framework with CERIST to develop AI speech-to-text solutions for Algerian dialects, to be deployed in the Assembly's data centre.

DZA.note: Staff training is only listed as a recommendation and aim; no programme is stated.
The Assembly data centre is named but not stated to rent to others.
No data protection law is stated.
No public digital-skills programme is stated.
Only a general strategy pillar on sovereignty; no state data rule, plan or hosting is stated.
No nationally owned data centre for hire is stated.
CERIST research is on speech-to-text, not digital policy.
Nothing stated on school internet or curriculum.
Only the Assembly's plan to sponsor startups; no startup law, strategy or fund is stated.

facts.fact: The Assembly's secretary general says an incubator for the parliaments of OIC member countries is being set up at the University of Constantine.
